reviewer: independent modeling_ui agent; did not author sculpt_provider.py or generation_service.py; own UI implementation excluded from this review
scope: Read-only provider/service integration and test review against frozen continuous-body runtime dependencies. Separate peer review owns the full sculpt_builder algorithm. Static anatomical asset provenance has separate independent reviews. No overall business or visual-quality pass.

observed_validation.scope: 10 static plan/provenance checks and durable synthetic-CLI jobs, including two actual Blender organic/continuous-character integration cases; no paid CLI calls
6 sculpt and5 prior Godot-modeling service routing, readiness, mode isolation and frozen restoration checks; local mocks only
Historical offline/legacy/Comfy service behavior against a local fixture HTTP server; no model inference

reviewed_boundaries: Configured sibling sculpt_builder.py, anatomy_base.py and anatomy_body.py bytes participate in the immutable provider fingerprint. Required assets and matching hashes are checked before provider CLI auth/submission and before/after Blender execution.

Model output is strict bounded v2 data. The fixed local Blender script is launched with --background --factory-startup --disable-autoexec. Generated executable code is neither accepted nor run; no Comfy or neural-model server is called by codex_sculpt.

Both ordered input/reference images retain node role/strength and CLI attachments. Distinct content hashes govern single-view versus multi-reference evidence. Text supplements observations or explicit edits; no unsupported numeric image/text model weight is claimed.

Completed CLI turn usage and raw response/event hashes are recorded before semantic validation. Invalid annotation prose fails with actionable feedback without normalizing model data, starting Blender or silently replaying a paid turn.

Original validated plan hash, expanded trusted-operator plan hash, native receipt byte hash, generated GLB hash, upstream asset source hashes and runtime module byte hashes remain distinct provenance fields.

Continuous character receipts require trusted BODY usage, five exact source-key names, consistent source/age hashes and canonical bounded age weights. They disclose requested/effective smoothing/subdivision and requested-but-unused voxel remeshing; no invisible voxel operation is claimed.

Body quality fields come from the fixed measured native receipt and output GLB validation, with shared finite resource bounds. Character output requires no internal voxel fills; organic numerical certificates are reduced to an honest public count/digest.

Cancellation and final states remain durable immutable SQLite terminals; heartbeats use separate lease records rather than rewriting image-bearing manifests. Unknown workers do not restart CLI requests.

codex_sculpt requires its Blender/local-data runtime for meshes but does not block independently available GPT images. Endpoint/model selection is unnecessary for this mode. Image and mesh providers have separate typed run-scoped snapshots; old codex_modeling/offline/legacy paths remain covered.

Readiness reports a connected CLI/executor, expressly requiring inspection of actual human/organic/occlusion results. It does not advertise character likeness, recovered hidden truth or overall visual acceptance.
provenance_name_note: quality.character_operator.anatomy_base_sha256 identifies the pinned upstream OBJ; runtime_input_sha256.anatomy_base_sha256 identifies the derived head module bytes. They are separate fields and are not interchangeable.

visual_acceptance_boundary.diagnostic_case: unchanged actual two-reference h1 plan under frozen builder; original failed task is untouched
observable_shape_properties: Continuous anatomical head/neck/shoulders/arms/wrists and five articulated digits per hand
Complete coherent front/back/profile body and clothing geometry
Natural paired facial landmarks and recognizable bald-human structure
Major previous primitive-assembly seams, needle artifacts and ball wrists are removed
remaining_material_shape_errors: Reference wrap jacket is closed/overlapped and visibly belted around the waist; diagnostic has a deep exposed V and belt largely occluded by its garment envelope
Back shows only a short belt block rather than the supplied wraparound waist structure
Loose cuffed reference trousers and narrower observed stance become relatively tapered legs and a wider foot stance
visual_acceptance_boundary.criterion: User-requested semi-realistic anatomy, image-led correspondence and multi-view consistency, not pixel-perfect identity or photogrammetry

limitations: Synthetic CLI with actual Blender tests validates engineering boundaries, not actual GPT model quality.
The diagnostic reuses a genuine earlier two-reference plan without a new model call. It is not converted into a new succeeded business task.
Actual newly frozen-model business cases and final engine acceptance are controlled by the root agent and are outside this component review.
